stage_note: Document build, document preview, and publication reserves apply to separate stages. Remove previews before publication. The local report reserve covers changed Git blobs after synchronized files replace their old copies.
additional_validation_note: One scheduled worker validates only previously admitted exact recurrence cases. Native fallback is disabled in that job. Existing application transient reserve covers its bounded input and output.
publication_reserve_note: The preflight measured 40,499,262 payload bytes. Increase the publication reserve to 40 MiB; the combined conservative peak remains below 10 GB.
